purpose: Fast causal Stage-A screen of two independent, closed-bar structural state machines not previously tested in DELTA: classic 1-2-3 reversal neckline break and MSnR rolling double-breakout staircase.

source_basis.disclosed_logic: Confirmed 1-2-3 swing reversal: point 1 extreme, point 2 reaction/neckline, point 3 holds on the reversal side of point 1, then neckline break confirms the reversal. Public TradingView implementation explicitly uses confirmed pivots and close-confirmed neckline breaks.
source_basis.project_fixture_disclosure: Pivot width 3 completed bars on each side is fixed before compute, consistent with the MQL5 discussion's up-to-three-bar swing description; no ATR score/buffer/retest layer is imported.

source_basis.disclosed_logic: A level = green candle followed by red, using green close; V level = red followed by green, using red close. Hold a rolling descending A pair or ascending V pair; breakout is checked before any new level; non-breaking new same-side level slides the pair, inner-step break restarts it; completed close through outer step confirms a Double Breakout.
source_basis.project_fixture_disclosure: The source exposes a Scan Length but indexed public text does not reveal its default. DELTA fixes scan_length_bars=120 before compute solely as a bounded stale-state guard; this is not represented as a source default.

17CS_123NB_M1.rule: confirmed alternating L-H-L with third low > first low -> first later completed close > middle high = LONG; mirror H-L-H with third high < first high -> first later completed close < middle low = SHORT; close beyond point1 invalidates before neckline break
17CS_123NB_M1.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after completed neckline-break bar edge

17CU_MSNR_DBO_M1.rule: source-described A/V rolling-pair state machine; completed Double A breakout emits LONG, completed Double V breakout emits SHORT; breakout check precedes new-level update
